body: Forward test of the promise-tracker method (not a recommendation). Probability 0.50 that: Skipper FY27 revenue growth ≥13% (its 'at worst' floor). Reason: H1 +7% requires strong H2; revenue promises ~52% delivered for core items. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier.
title: Paper call: Skipper FY27 revenue growth ≥13% (its 'at worst' floor)
